privacy_policy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy_policy.intro: Welcome to Fire Arena, a gaming platform where users can compete in Pong and Tic-Tac-Toe. We take your privacy seriously and respect your personal information. This Privacy Policy explains what data we collect, how we use it, and your rights regarding your information.
privacy_policy.collect_account_text: When you create an account on Fire Arena, we collect:
privacy_policy.collect_account_password: Password (securely hashed, never stored in plain text)
privacy_policy.collect_device_text: We collect the following for security and analytics purposes:
privacy_policy.not_collect_text: Fire Arena explicitly does not collect:
privacy_policy.not_collect_files: Uploaded files, images, documents, or profile photos
privacy_policy.not_collect_forms: Contact form submissions (none exist on Fire Arena)
privacy_policy.tracking_text: Fire Arena does not use the following third-party tracking or advertising tools:
privacy_policy.tracking_hotjar: Session replay or heatmap services from third parties
privacy_policy.tracking_note: We do not display ads or use any third-party tracking services. Our analytics are internal only.
privacy_policy.sharing_text: Fire Arena does not sell personal data. We may share limited data only with:
privacy_policy.sharing_vendors: Infrastructure and hosting providers needed to run the service
privacy_policy.sharing_delivery: Email delivery providers for verification and password-reset messages
privacy_policy.sharing_crm: Security, abuse-prevention, or operational support providers
privacy_policy.sharing_ads: Legal authorities when required by law or to protect the service
privacy_policy.sharing_note: We do not sell personal data or share it for advertising. Any limited disclosure is only for operating, securing, or legally complying with the service.
privacy_policy.usage_text: Your information is used only for:
privacy_policy.usage_play: Allowing you to play and compete in games
privacy_policy.usage_analytics: Providing you with personal analytics about your gameplay
privacy_policy.usage_improvement: Improving the Fire Arena platform and user experience
privacy_policy.cookies_text: Fire Arena does not intentionally use cookies for advertising or tracking purposes.
privacy_policy.cookies_note: If Fire Arena uses authentication or session cookies, they are only for:
privacy_policy.cookies_note2: These cookies are essential for the platform to function and are not used for profiling or marketing.
privacy_policy.retention_text: Your personal data is retained as follows:
privacy_policy.retention_active: While your account is active: We keep your data to provide the service.
privacy_policy.retention_after: After account deletion or inactivity: Some data may be retained for a reasonable period for legal, security, or technical reasons (such as backup restoration).
privacy_policy.security_text: Fire Arena takes data security seriously:
privacy_policy.security_hosting: The platform uses secure hosting practices
privacy_policy.security_rbac: Access to operational data is restricted by least-privilege access controls
privacy_policy.security_note: No system is 100% secure. While we work hard to protect your information, we cannot guarantee absolute security. Please use a strong, unique password for your account.
privacy_policy.children_text: Fire Arena may be used by younger users. We do not knowingly collect unnecessary personal data from children beyond what is required to create an account and play.
privacy_policy.children_contact: If you are a parent or guardian and believe your child has provided personal data to Fire Arena inappropriately, please contact us immediately using the contact information below.
privacy_policy.rights_ask: Ask questions about your personal data
privacy_policy.rights_request: Request information about what data we hold
privacy_policy.rights_contact: Contact Fire Arena for privacy-related questions
privacy_policy.rights_deletion: Account deletion: Account deletion is not currently available through the platform self-service. Please contact us to request deletion of your account and associated data.
privacy_policy.changes_text: Fire Arena may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. When we make material changes, we will notify you by updating the "Last Updated" date at the top of this page.
privacy_policy.changes_note: Your continued use of Fire Arena after changes means you accept the updated policy.
privacy_policy.contact_text: If you have questions, concerns, or requests related to this Privacy Policy or your data, please contact:
